summary: You can reach real emotional depth when you choose to. The power to transform your own patterns is there, available the moment you turn toward it. It won't force itself on you.
body: You can reach real emotional depth when you choose to. The power to transform your own patterns is there, available the moment you turn toward it. It won't force itself on you. Left alone, you might skate the surface and keep the deep stuff locked away. But when you go looking, you can rework old emotional patterns at the root, the kind of change most people never manage. The opening rewards courage. Reach in and you get to rebuild yourself from the inside.
gift: At your best: capable of deep, deliberate emotional change.
shadow: The trap: keeping the deep stuff locked and skating the surface instead.
integration: Let emotional needs and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Emotional intensity: depth is an asset, volatility a liability.
do: Go looking for the pattern at the root
Reach in when it would be easier not to
dont: Wait for a crisis to make you go there
